replacedFields: uuid, session_id, request_id, message.id, and every tool-use ID were rewritten to deterministic synthetic aliases in first-appearance order
message.model was replaced with the constant "fixture-model"
every text, thinking, signature, and tool-result string was replaced with bounded synthetic text
every tool input value was replaced with a per-key placeholder; only the key shape is retained
partial_json argument bytes were replaced with a bounded synthetic JSON fragment
droppedFrameTypes: every other SDK message kind the capture path does not translate

provenance.captured: Converted from a live local capture by scripts/captureFixtures.mjs. The raw capture never enters the repository.
provenance.synthetic: Hand-authored from a shape the live capture did not produce. Verified against the installed SDK type declarations for BetaRawMessageStreamEvent and SDKAssistantMessage.

notes: The SDK and legacy stream-json transports read the same CLI output, so the split-thinking-toolsearch fixture is byte-identical under both transports.
Regenerate every captured fixture when the SDK or CLI version changes; exact-capture claims are pinned to the versions above.
